entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • BlazorWebView may have compatibility issues with Android 12.0 and earlier. #32860
    .NET 10 Servicing
  • CollectionView does not adjust the ScrollView content insets for edge-to-edge scrolling #32855
  • iOS ScrollView/CollectionView do not start scrolling when touch begins on Button or item (regression from MAUI 9 → MAUI 10) #32852
  • [CI] Failing to create Android emulator #32846
  • [Android] MediaPicker stops working after lauching other ComponentActivity. #32845
    .NET 10 Servicing

Closed

  • SourceGen: Error CS0030 string to Color #32836
    .NET 10.0 SR2

    .NET 10.0 SR2

  • Migrate to Arcade publishing infrastructure #2139
    Backlog

    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Fix XC0022 warnings for src/Controls/tests/TestCases.HostApp #31734
    Backlog
